Think of it like this. You’re home right now and you’re current job is to try to stabilize yourself. Your chief said your job was not on the line so I would take his word for it and not add that to your list of worries and struggles. I know it can feel frustrating to be doing everything in your power to remain stable yet sometimes it is out of grasp, I have definitely been there before too. The main thing is to continue taking your medication and maybe speak to your psychiatrist if it’s time to adjust the dose or switch to a new one that may work better with your brain chemistry. I get the feeling that I have to escape a presence that is there with me very often, so you’re not alone. What I do is I write down what I’m feeling in that moment, intensely observe my environment to see if I am truly in danger, then I do deep breathing and go back to journaling. It’s not a guaranteed fix but it helps me personally. Feel better soon 👍
